To all and especially  to <@UQH93QFNV> <@U02DXRYCD2N> and <@U01PU2BUHU5> :
Jo Ellen Kaiser alerted me to see this FaceBook Live panel especially14 min about reframing and *Public Press was mentioned at 18:31 by Katherine Schaff of Berkeley Media Studies Group (BMSG) when she referred to a Laura Wenus et al virtual panel in 2020, Bay Area Black Community Leaders Envision Equitable Coronavirus Response.*

(BMSG is developing a reporters toolkit on housing and BARHII is focused on a Black Housing Strategy with 40 organizations coordinating their strategies.)

*<https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=1167638050475595>*
Connecting Housing Justice and Journalism: with Berkeley Media Studies Group, BARHII, and housing reporters
Tues, 5/10 @ 12pm PST/3pm EST
Part of San Francisco's Affordable Housing Week 2022.
*Panelists:*
Kathi Schaff, Berkeley Media Studies Group
Darris Young, Bay Area Health Inequities Initiative
*Laura Wenus, SF Chronicle*
Laura Waxmann, SF Business Times
Manuela Tobias, CalMatters
